title.zh: 卷四十七 志第二十八: 食貨二 田制 租賦 牛頭稅
title.en: Volume 47 Treatises 28: Finance and Economics 2 - Administration of Farming, Rent and Taxes, Taxes on Oxes
title.raw: 卷四十七 志第二十八: 食貨二 田制 租賦 牛頭稅 Volume 47 Treatises 28: Finance and Economics 2 - Administration of Farming, Rent and Taxes, Taxes on Oxes

sentences.zh: 量田以營造尺，五尺為步，闊一步，長二百四十步為畝，百畝為頃。

translations.literal: Fields were measured with the construction-standard foot; five feet made one pace; one pace in width and two hundred forty paces in length made one mu; one hundred mu made one qing.
translations.idiomatic: Land was surveyed using the construction-standard foot measure: five feet to the pace, and one mu was defined as one pace wide by two hundred forty paces long; one hundred mu constituted a qing.

sentences.zh: 民田業各從其便，賣質於人無禁，但令隨地輸租而已。

translations.literal: For civilian fields, each household followed its own convenience in managing its holdings; selling or pledging land to others was not forbidden—only that rent be paid according to the land was required.
translations.idiomatic: Private landowners could manage their holdings as they saw fit, and were free to sell or mortgage their land; the sole requirement was that rent be paid on whatever parcel the land happened to be.

sentences.zh: 凡桑棗，民戶以多植為勤，少者必植其地十之三，猛安謀克戶少者必課種其地十之一，除枯補新，使之不闕。

translations.literal: As for mulberry and jujube trees, civilian households were regarded as diligent when they planted many; those with few had to plant three-tenths of their land; meng'an-mouke households with few had to be assessed to plant one-tenth of their land; dead trees were removed and new ones planted so that none were lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry and jujube cultivation was encouraged among civilian households, and those who planted sparingly were required to set aside three-tenths of their land for these trees; meng'an-mouke households faced a one-tenth planting quota. Dead trees were to be replaced so that plantings never fell short.

sentences.zh: 凡官地，猛安謀克及貧民請射者，寬鄉一丁百畝，狹鄉十畝，中男半之。

translations.literal: As for government land, when meng'an-mouke and poor people requested allocation, in broad districts one adult male received one hundred mu, in narrow districts ten mu, and zhongnan received half.
translations.idiomatic: When meng'an-mouke households or the poor applied to claim government land, allotments were one hundred mu per adult male in spacious districts, ten mu in crowded districts, and half those amounts for zhongnan (sub-adult males).

sentences.zh: 請射荒地者，以最下第五等減半定租，八年始征之。

translations.literal: Those who requested allocation of wasteland had rent fixed at half the lowest fifth grade, and collection began only after eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Applicants for wasteland received rent assessed at half the lowest fifth-grade rate, with collection deferred for eight years.

sentences.zh: 作己業者以第七等減半為稅，七年始征之。

translations.literal: Those who developed land as their own holding were taxed at half the seventh grade, and collection began after seven years.
translations.idiomatic: Those who brought land under cultivation as private holdings were taxed at half the seventh-grade rate, with collection beginning after seven years.

sentences.zh: 自首冒佃比鄰地者，輸官租三分之二。

translations.literal: Those who voluntarily reported having encroached on and cultivated neighboring land paid two-thirds of the official rent.
translations.idiomatic: Those who confessed to having encroached on and farmed adjacent land paid two-thirds of the standard official rent.

sentences.zh: 佃黃河退灘者，次年納租。

translations.literal: Those who cultivated the Yellow River's receded flood flats paid rent the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants who farmed the Yellow River's newly exposed flood flats began paying rent in the year after cultivation.

sentences.zh: 太宗天會九年五月，始分遣諸路勸農之使者。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Tianhui under Emperor Taizong, envoys to encourage agriculture were first dispatched to the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tianhui 9 (1131), under Emperor Taizong, the court first dispatched agricultural commissioners to the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 熙宗天眷十四年，罷來流、混同間護邏地，以予民耕牧，海陵正隆元年二月，遣刑部尚書紇石烈婁室等十一人，分行大興府、山東，真定府，拘括系官或荒閑牧地，及官民占射逃絕戶地，戍兵占佃宮籍監、外路官本業外增置土田，及大興府，平州路僧尼道士女冠等地，蓋以授所遷之猛安謀克戶，且令民請射，而官得其租也。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Tianjuan under Emperor Xizong, the protected Liao borderlands between the Lailiu and Hun Tong rivers were abolished and given to the people for farming and grazing. In the second month of the first year of Zhenglong under Prince Hailing, the Minister of Justice Wanyan Loushi and ten others were sent separately through Daxing Prefecture, Shandong, and Zhending Prefecture to consolidate government-held or idle pasture land, land claimed by officials and commoners from extinct households, land garrison soldiers occupied beyond their registered holdings and supervisors' estates, and land held by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and nuns in Daxing Prefecture and Pingzhou Circuit—chiefly to grant to relocated meng'an-mouke households, while also allowing the people to apply for allocation, with the state receiving the rent.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjuan 14 (1151), under Emperor Xizong, the protected Liao frontier between the Lailiu and Hun Tong rivers was opened to civilian farming and grazing. In the second month of Zhenglong 1 (1156), Prince Hailing dispatched Minister of Justice Wanyan Loushi and ten colleagues through Daxing, Shandong, and Zhending to consolidate state and idle pasture lands, claims on defunct households' property, garrison encroachments beyond registered holdings, and monastic lands in Daxing and Pingzhou—primarily to resettle relocated meng'an-mouke households, while permitting civilians to claim plots and the state to collect rent.

sentences.zh: 世宗大定五年十二月，上以京畿兩猛安民戶不自耕墾，及伐桑棗為薪鬻之，命大興少尹完顏讓巡察。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, because households in the two meng'an units of the capital region did not cultivate for themselves and cut mulberry and jujube for firewood to sell, the emperor ordered Daxing Vice Prefect Wanyan Rang to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Dading 5 (1165), Emperor Shizong learned that households in the capital's two meng'an units were neither farming their own land nor harvesting mulberry and jujube for sale as firewood, and ordered Daxing Vice Prefect Wanyan Rang to investigate.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，禁侵耕圍場地。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year, encroachment on and cultivation of hunting-park land was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year (1170), encroachment on imperial hunting grounds was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 十一年，謂侍臣曰：「往歲，清暑山西，傍路皆禾稼，殆無牧地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he said to his attendants: "In past years, when taking the cool retreat in western Shanxi, crops lined the roadsides and there was scarcely pastureland."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1171), he told his attendants: "When I took the summer retreat in western Shanxi in earlier years, grain fields lined every roadside and pastureland had all but disappeared."

sentences.zh: 嘗下令，使民五裏外乃得耕墾。

translations.literal: An order had been issued that the people might cultivate only five li beyond the roads.
translations.idiomatic: I had ordered that cultivation be permitted only five li from the roads.

sentences.zh: 今聞其民以此去之他所，甚可矜憫。

translations.literal: Now I hear that because of this the people have left for other places, which is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear that people have abandoned their homes and moved elsewhere because of this restriction—truly a matter for compassion.

sentences.zh: 其令依舊耕種，毋致失業。

translations.literal: Let them be ordered to farm as before and not lose their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Let them resume farming as before, so that none lose their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 凡害民之事患在不知，知之朕必不為。

translations.literal: In all matters that harm the people, the trouble lies in not knowing; once I know, I certainly will not do them.
translations.idiomatic: Harm to the people arises from ignorance; once I know of it, I will not permit it.

sentences.zh: 自今事有類此，卿等即告毋隱。

translations.literal: From now on, whenever there are matters of this kind, you must report at once and not conceal them.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, report any similar situation to me immediately—do not withhold it.

sentences.zh: 」十三年，敕有司：「每歲遣官勸猛安謀克農事，恐有煩擾。

translations.literal: " In the thirteenth year, he instructed the responsible offices: "Each year dispatching officials to encourage meng'an-mouke agriculture may cause harassment."
translations.idiomatic: " In the thirteenth year (1173), he directed the responsible offices: "Sending officials every year to supervise meng'an-mouke farming is apt to become a nuisance."

sentences.zh: 自今止令各管職官勸督，弛慢者舉劾以聞。

translations.literal: From now on, let only each supervising official encourage and oversee; those who are lax shall be impeached and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, let local supervising officials handle encouragement and oversight, and impeach and report any who are negligent.

sentences.zh: 」十七年六月，刑州男子趙迪簡言：「隨路不附籍官田及河灘地，皆為豪強所占，而貧民土瘠稅重，乞遣官拘籍冒佃者，定立租課，複量減人戶稅數，庶得輕重均平。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, a man of Xingzhou named Zhao Di submitted a brief petition: "Along the circuits, unregistered government fields and river-bank lands are all occupied by powerful families, while the poor face poor soil and heavy taxes. I beg that officials be sent to register encroachers, fix rent assessments, and again measure and reduce household tax quotas so that burdens may be balanced."
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of the seventeenth year (1177), Zhao Di of Xingzhou submitted a petition: "Unregistered government fields and river flats along the circuits are monopolized by powerful families, while the poor struggle on barren soil under crushing taxes. I request that officials register illegal occupiers, set fair rents, and reduce household tax quotas so that burdens fall evenly."

sentences.zh: 」詔付有司，將行而止。

translations.literal: " An edict referred it to the responsible offices; it was about to be implemented but then halted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court referred the matter to the responsible offices, but implementation was begun and then stopped.

sentences.zh: 複以近都猛安謀克所給官地率皆薄瘠，豪民租佃官田歲久，往往冒為己業，令拘籍之。

translations.literal: Again, because the government land allotted to meng'an-mouke near the capital was mostly thin and poor, and powerful people who rented government fields for many years often falsely claimed them as their own holdings, an order was issued to register and consolidate them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also noted that government land allotted to capital-region meng'an-mouke was mostly poor, while wealthy tenants who had long rented state fields often claimed them as private property; he ordered these lands registered and reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 又謂省臣曰：「官地非民誰種，然女直人戶自鄉土三四千里移來，盡得薄地，若不拘刷良田給之，久必貪乏，其遣官察之。

translations.literal: He also said to the provincial ministers: "If not the people, who will plant government land? Yet Jurchen households have moved three or four thousand li from their homelands and all received poor land. If good fields are not seized and given to them, in time they will surely become impoverished. Send officials to investigate."
translations.idiomatic: He told the provincial ministers: "Who else will farm government land if not the people? Yet Jurchen households uprooted from homelands three or four thousand li away have received only poor soil. Unless we allocate good fields to them, they will grow impoverished in time—send officials to investigate."

sentences.zh: 」又謂參知政事張汝弼曰：「先嘗遣問女直土地，皆雲良田。

translations.literal: " He also said to Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Rubi: "Earlier I sent people to inquire about Jurchen lands, and all said they were good fields."
translations.idiomatic: " He also told Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Rubi: "When I previously sent inquiries about Jurchen land allotments, everyone reported fertile fields."

sentences.zh: 及朕出獵，因問之，則謂自起移至此，不能種蒔，斫蘆為席，或斬芻以自給。

translations.literal: When I went hunting and asked in person, they said that since moving here they could not plant crops and instead cut reeds for mats or mowed grass to support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: But when I went hunting and asked directly, they said that since relocating they could not farm at all—they cut reeds for mats or gathered fodder merely to survive.

sentences.zh: 卿等其議之。

translations.literal: You must deliberate on this.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberate on this matter.

sentences.zh: 」省臣奏：「官地所以人多蔽匿盜耕者，由其罪輕故也。

translations.literal: " The provincial ministers memorialized: "The reason many conceal and secretly cultivate government land is that the penalty is light."
translations.idiomatic: " The provincial ministers replied: "People conceal and illegally farm government land because the penalties are too lenient."

sentences.zh: 」乃更條約，立限令人自陳，過限則人能告者有賞。

translations.literal: " Regulations were then revised, a deadline set for voluntary disclosure, and after the deadline informants who reported others were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: " New regulations were drawn up setting a deadline for voluntary disclosure; after it expired, informants who reported violators would be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 遣同知中都路轉運使張九思往拘籍之。

translations.literal: Associate Commissioner of the Zhongdu Circuit Transport Office Zhang Jiusi was sent to register and consolidate the land.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Commissioner Zhang Jiusi of the Zhongdu Circuit Transport Office was dispatched to register and reclaim the land.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，上如春水，見民桑多為牧畜齧毀，詔親王公主及勢要家，牧畜有犯民桑者，許所屬縣官立加懲斷。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year, when the emperor went to the spring hunt, he saw that the people's mulberry trees were largely destroyed by grazing livestock. He decreed that when livestock of princes, princesses, and powerful families damaged civilians' mulberry trees, the county officials of the relevant jurisdiction might immediately impose punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year (1179), during the spring hunt, the emperor saw mulberry trees destroyed by grazing livestock. He decreed that county officials might immediately punish any prince, princess, or powerful household whose animals damaged civilian mulberry groves.

sentences.zh: 十二月謂宰臣曰：「亡遼時所撥地，與本朝元帥府，已曾拘籍矣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he said to the chief ministers: "Land allocated in the defunct Liao period and by our dynasty's Marshal's Office has already been registered and consolidated."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he told the chief ministers: "Land allocated under the defunct Liao and by our dynasty's Marshal's Office has already been registered and reclaimed."

sentences.zh: 民或指射為無主地，租佃及新開荒為己業者可以拘括。

translations.literal: When commoners pointed to and claimed land as ownerless, or rented and newly opened wasteland as their own holdings, such land may be consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: Land that commoners have claimed as ownerless, or rented and newly cleared as private holdings, may still be subject to consolidation.

sentences.zh: 其間播種歲久，若遽奪之，恐民失業。

translations.literal: Among these, where planting has continued for many years, if it is seized abruptly, I fear the people will lose their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Where land has been under cultivation for many years, sudden confiscation may strip people of their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 」因詔括地官張九思戒之。

translations.literal: " He therefore instructed the land-consolidation officer Zhang Jiusi to heed this warning.
translations.idiomatic: " He accordingly admonished land-consolidation officer Zhang Jiusi to bear this in mind.

sentences.zh: 複謂宰臣曰：「朕聞括地事所行極不當，如皇后莊、太子務之類，止以名稱便為官地，百姓所執憑驗，一切不問，其相鄰冒占官地，複有倖免者。

translations.literal: He again said to the chief ministers: "I hear that the land consolidation has been conducted most improperly. Places such as the Queen's Estate and the Crown Prince's Office are treated as government land on name alone; credentials held by commoners are not examined at all; and those who encroached on neighboring government land have in some cases escaped."
translations.idiomatic: He again told the chief ministers: "I hear the land consolidation has been grossly mishandled. Sites such as the Queen's Estate and the Crown Prince's Office are seized as government land on title alone, while commoners' title documents go unexamined, and some who encroached on adjacent state land have escaped scrutiny."

sentences.zh: 能使軍戶稍給，民不失業，乃朕之心也。

translations.literal: To enable military households to gain some provision and the people not to lose their livelihood—that is my intent.
translations.idiomatic: My aim is to provide for military households while ensuring civilians do not lose their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 」二十年四月，以行幸道隘，扈從人不便，詔戶部沿路頓舍側近官地，勿租與民耕種。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month of the twentieth year, because the imperial procession route was narrow and inconvenient for the entourage, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered that government land near roadside lodges along the route not be rented out for the people to cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth month of the twentieth year (1180), because the imperial procession route was too narrow for the entourage, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered not to rent out government land near roadside lodges along the route for civilian cultivation.

sentences.zh: 又詔故太保阿裏先於山東路撥地百四十頃，大定初又于中都路賜田百頃，命拘山東之地入官。

translations.literal: It was also decreed that the late Grand Guardian Ali Xian had been allotted one hundred forty qing in Shandong Circuit, and at the beginning of Dading had been granted one hundred qing in Zhongdu Circuit; the Shandong land was ordered consolidated into government holdings.
translations.idiomatic: It was also decreed that the late Grand Guardian Ali Xian had received allotments of one hundred forty qing in Shandong and, at the start of the Dading era, one hundred qing in Zhongdu; his Shandong holdings were ordered reclaimed for the state.

sentences.zh: 五月，諭有司曰：「白石門至野狐嶺，其間澱濼多為民耕植者，而官民雜畜往來無牧放之所，可差官括元荒地及冒佃之數。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month, he instructed the responsible offices: "From Baishimen to Yehu Ridge, the lakes and marshes between are largely cultivated by the people, yet officials and commoners drive mixed herds through with nowhere to graze them. Officials may be dispatched to consolidate original wasteland and encroached holdings."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he instructed the responsible offices: "Between Baishimen and Yehu Ridge, lakes and marshes are largely under cultivation, yet officials and commoners drive mixed herds through with nowhere to pasture them. Dispatch officials to consolidate original wasteland and illegally occupied plots."

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，上謂宰臣曰：「山東、大名等路猛安謀克戶之民，往往驕縱，不親稼穡，不令家人農作，盡令漢人佃蒔，取租而已。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year, the emperor said to the chief ministers: "In Shandong, Daming, and other circuits, people of meng'an-mouke households are often arrogant and indulgent, do not personally attend to farming, do not have their families farm, and entirely have Han people tenant-cultivate and merely collect rent."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year (1181), the emperor told the chief ministers: "In Shandong, Daming, and other circuits, meng'an-mouke households are often arrogant—they neither farm themselves nor require their families to do so, but lease everything to Han tenants and merely collect rent."

sentences.zh: 富家盡服紈綺，酒食遊宴，貧者爭慕效之，欲望家給人足，難矣！

translations.literal: The wealthy all wear silk and brocade, feast and banquet, and the poor vie to emulate them—how difficult to expect that every household be provided for!
translations.idiomatic: The wealthy dress in silk, feast and carouse, and the poor strive to imitate them—how can we expect every household to prosper?

sentences.zh: 近已禁賣奴婢，約其凶吉之禮，更當委官閱實戶數，計口授地，必令自耕，力不贍者，方許佃於人。

translations.literal: Recently the sale of male and female slaves has been forbidden and their funeral and wedding rites regulated. Officials should further be commissioned to verify household numbers, allocate land by head count, and require self-cultivation; only when strength is insufficient may they rent to others.
translations.idiomatic: We have recently banned the sale of slaves and regulated funeral and wedding rites. Officials should verify household registers, allocate land by head count, and require self-cultivation—leasing to others should be permitted only when households lack the labor to farm for themselves.

sentences.zh: 仍禁其農時飲酒。

translations.literal: Drinking during the farming season is still forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking during the farming season should also be prohibited.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「奚人六猛安，已徙居咸平、臨潢、泰州，其地肥沃，且精勤農務，各安其居。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The six Xi meng'an units have been relocated to Xianping, Linhuang, and Taizhou; the land is fertile and they are diligent in farming, each secure in their dwelling."
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "The six Xi meng'an units relocated to Xianping, Linhuang, and Taizhou have fertile land and farm diligently—they are settled and content."

sentences.zh: 女直人徙居奚地者，菽粟得收穫否？

translations.literal: For Jurchens relocated to Xi territory, do they obtain harvests of beans and grain?
translations.idiomatic: Are Jurchens relocated to former Xi territory harvesting beans and grain successfully?

sentences.zh: 」左丞守道對曰：「聞皆自耕，歲用亦足。

translations.literal: " Left Vice Councilor Shoudao replied: "I hear they all farm for themselves and their annual needs are sufficient."
translations.idiomatic: " Left Vice Councilor Shoudao replied: "I hear they all farm for themselves and their annual needs are met."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「彼地肥美，異於他處，惟附都民以水害稼者賑之。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "That land is fertile and unlike other places; only relieve those near the capital whose crops were harmed by flood."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "That land is uniquely fertile—relieve only those near the capital whose crops were damaged by flooding."

sentences.zh: 」三月，陳言者言，豪強之家多占奪田者。

translations.literal: " In the third month, a petitioner stated that powerful families widely seized others' fields.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month, a petitioner reported that powerful families were widely seizing others' land.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「前參政納合椿年占地八百頃，又聞山西田亦多為權要所占，有一家一口至三十頃者，以致小民無田可耕，徙居陰山之惡地，何以自存？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Former Vice Councilor Nahan Chunnian occupied eight hundred qing of land, and I also hear that in Shanxi many fields are occupied by the powerful—some households of one person hold up to thirty qing—so that common people have no land to farm and move to the harsh lands of the Yin Mountains; how can they survive?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Former Vice Councilor Nahan Chunnian held eight hundred qing, and I hear that in Shanxi powerful families monopolize farmland—some single-person households hold thirty qing—leaving commoners landless and driving them to the harsh Yin Mountains. How can they survive?"

sentences.zh: 其令占官地十頃以上者皆括籍入官，將均賜貧民。

translations.literal: Let all who occupy ten qing or more of government land be registered and taken into government holdings, to be evenly granted to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Order that all holdings of ten qing or more of government land be registered and confiscated, then distributed evenly to the poor.

sentences.zh: 」省臣又奏：「椿年子猛安參謀合、故太師耨碗溫敦思忠孫長壽等，親屬計七十余家，所占地三千餘頃。

translations.literal: " The provincial ministers further memorialized: "Chunnian's son, Meng'an Can Mouhe, the late Grand Preceptor Nao'ai Wendun Sizhong's grandson Changshou, and others—more than seventy related households in all—occupied more than three thousand qing."
translations.idiomatic: " The provincial ministers added: "Chunnian's son Meng'an Can Mouhe, the late Grand Preceptor Nao'ai Wendun Sizhong's grandson Changshou, and their kin—over seventy households in all—held more than three thousand qing."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「至秋，除牛頭地外，仍各給十頃，餘皆拘入官。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "By autumn, apart from ox-head tax land, still grant each ten qing; the rest shall all be taken into government holdings."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "By autumn, apart from ox-head tax allotments, grant each household ten qing and confiscate the remainder for the state."

sentences.zh: 山后招討司所括者，亦當同此也。

translations.literal: What the Rear Mountains Pacification Commission consolidated should be treated the same.
translations.idiomatic: Land consolidated by the Rear Mountains Pacification Commission should be handled likewise.

sentences.zh: 」又謂宰臣曰：「山東路所括民田，已分給女直屯田人戶，複有籍官閑地，依元數還民，仍免租稅。

translations.literal: " He again said to the chief ministers: "Civilian fields consolidated in Shandong Circuit have already been distributed to Jurchen garrison-farming households; registered idle government land should be returned to the people in the original amounts, and rent and tax still waived."
translations.idiomatic: " He again told the chief ministers: "Consolidated civilian fields in Shandong have been allotted to Jurchen garrison-farming households; registered idle government land should be returned to civilians in the original amounts, with rent and tax waived."

sentences.zh: 」六月，上謂省臣曰：「近者大興府平、灤、薊、通、順等州，經水災之地，免今年稅租。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, the emperor said to the provincial ministers: "Recently in Daxing Prefecture and the prefectures of Ping, Luan, Ji, Tong, and Shun, places that suffered flood disaster are exempt from this year's rent and tax."
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month, the emperor told the provincial ministers: "In Daxing and the prefectures of Ping, Luan, Ji, Tong, and Shun, areas stricken by flooding are exempt from this year's rent and tax."

sentences.zh: 不罹水災者姑停夏稅，俟稔歲征之。

translations.literal: Those not afflicted by flood shall for now suspend the summer tax and collect it in a bountiful year.
translations.idiomatic: Areas not flooded shall have the summer tax deferred until a good harvest year.

sentences.zh: 」時中都大水，而濱，棣等州及山后大熟，命修治懷來以南道路，以來糶者。

translations.literal: " At this time the central capital suffered great flood, while Bin, Di, and other prefectures and the rear mountains had great harvests; repair of roads south of Huailai was ordered to bring in grain sellers.
translations.idiomatic: " The central capital was severely flooded, while Bin, Di, and other prefectures and the rear mountains enjoyed bumper harvests; roads south of Huailai were ordered repaired to facilitate grain shipments.

sentences.zh: 又命都城減價以糶。

translations.literal: The capital was also ordered to sell grain at reduced prices.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was also ordered to sell grain at reduced prices.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「近遣使閱視秋稼，聞猛安謀克人惟酒是務，往往以田租人，而預借三二年租課者。

translations.literal: He also said: "Recently envoys were sent to inspect the autumn crops. I hear that meng'an-mouke people devote themselves only to wine, often assign fields to rent-collectors, and even borrow two or three years' rent in advance."
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Envoys recently inspected the autumn harvest and report that meng'an-mouke households care only for drink—they often hand fields to rent-collectors and even borrow two or three years' rent in advance."

sentences.zh: 或種而不耘，聽其荒蕪者。

translations.literal: Some plant but do not weed and allow fields to lie waste.
translations.idiomatic: Some plant but neglect weeding, allowing fields to lie fallow.

sentences.zh: 自今皆令閱實各戶人力，可耨幾頃畝，必使自耕耘之，其力果不及者方許租賃。

translations.literal: From now on, let each household's labor be verified—how many qing and mu they can hoe—and they must be made to cultivate themselves; only when their strength truly falls short may they rent out.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, verify each household's labor capacity—how many qing and mu they can work—and require self-cultivation; leasing out land should be permitted only when labor is genuinely insufficient.

sentences.zh: 如惰農飲酒，勸農謀克及本管猛安謀克並都管，各以等第科罪。

translations.literal: If they are lazy in farming or drink, the agricultural encouragement mouke, the supervising meng'an-mouke, and the regional overseer shall each be punished by graded penalties.
translations.idiomatic: Lazy farmers and drinkers shall trigger graded penalties for their agricultural encouragement mouke, supervising meng'an-mouke, and regional overseers.

sentences.zh: 收穫數多者，則亦以等第遷賞。

translations.literal: Those with large harvests shall likewise receive graded promotions and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Those with large harvests shall likewise receive graded promotions and rewards.

sentences.zh: 」七月，上謂宰臣曰：「前徙宗室戶於河間，撥地處之，而不回納舊地，豈有兩地皆占之理？

translations.literal: " In the seventh month, the emperor said to the chief ministers: "Earlier imperial clan households were moved to Hejian and allotted land there, but did not return their old land—how can there be reason to hold both places?"
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month, the emperor told the chief ministers: "When imperial clan households were relocated to Hejian and allotted new land, they did not surrender their old holdings—how can anyone occupy land in two places?"

sentences.zh: 自今當以一處賜之。

translations.literal: From now on they should be granted only one place.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, grant land in only one location.

sentences.zh: 山東刷民田已分給女直屯田戶，複有餘地，當以還民而免是歲之租。

translations.literal: Civilian fields consolidated in Shandong have been distributed to Jurchen garrison-farming households; if there is surplus land, it should be returned to the people and this year's rent waived.
translations.idiomatic: Consolidated civilian fields in Shandong allotted to Jurchen garrison-farming households left surplus land, which should be returned to civilians with this year's rent waived.

sentences.zh: 」八月，尚書省奏山東所刷地數，上謂梁肅曰：「朕嘗以此問卿，卿不以言。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized the amount of land consolidated in Shandong. The emperor said to Liang Su: "I once asked you about this and you did not speak."
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month, the Ministry of Revenue reported the amount of land consolidated in Shandong. The emperor said to Liang Su: "I once asked you about this, and you said nothing."

sentences.zh: 此雖稱民地，然皆無明據，括為官地有何不可？

translations.literal: Although this is called civilian land, it all lacks clear proof—what objection is there to consolidating it as government land?
translations.idiomatic: Though called civilian land, none of it has clear title—why should it not be consolidated as government land?

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「黃河已移故道，梁山濼水退，地甚廣，已嘗遣使安置屯田。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The Yellow River has shifted to its old course; the Liangshan Marsh waters have receded and the land is very broad. Envoys have already been sent to establish garrison farming."
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "The Yellow River has returned to its old course and the Liangshan Marsh has receded, exposing vast tracts—we have already sent envoys to establish garrison farms."

sentences.zh: 民昔嘗恣意種之，今官已籍其地，而民懼征其租，逃者甚眾。

translations.literal: The people once planted freely; now the government has registered the land, but the people fear rent will be levied and many have fled.
translations.idiomatic: People once farmed the area freely, but now that the state has registered the land, many have fled for fear of rent.

sentences.zh: 若征其租，而以冒佃不即出首罪論之，固宜。

translations.literal: To levy rent and punish failure to report encroachment promptly is indeed proper.
translations.idiomatic: Levying rent and punishing those who failed to report encroachment promptly would be just.

sentences.zh: 然若遽取之，恐致失所。

translations.literal: Yet if it is seized abruptly, I fear they will lose their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Yet sudden confiscation may leave them destitute.

sentences.zh: 可免其征，赦其罪，別以官地給之。

translations.literal: Their rent may be waived, their crimes pardoned, and other government land granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Waive their rent, pardon their offenses, and grant them other government land instead.

sentences.zh: 」禦史台奏：「大名、濟州因刷梁山濼官地，或有以民地被刷者。

translations.literal: " The Censorate memorialized: "In Daming and Jizhou, because Liangshan Marsh government land was consolidated, some civilian land was also consolidated."
translations.idiomatic: " The Censorate reported: "In Daming and Jizhou, consolidation of Liangshan Marsh government land also swept up some civilian holdings."

sentences.zh: 」上複召宰臣曰：「雖曾經通檢納稅，而無明驗者，複當刷 問。

translations.literal: " The emperor again summoned the chief ministers and said: "Even if land passed general inspection and paid tax, if there is no clear proof it should again be subject to consolidation inquiry."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor again summoned the chief ministers: "Even land that passed general inspection and paid taxes, if lacking clear proof, should be reinvestigated during consolidation."

sentences.zh: 有公據者，雖付本人，仍須體問。

translations.literal: Where there are official documents, even if returned to the holder, inquiry must still be conducted.
translations.idiomatic: Even where official title documents exist, land returned to holders must still be investigated.

sentences.zh: 」十月，複與張仲愈論冒占田事。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month, he again discussed encroachment on land with Zhang Zhongyu.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth month, he again discussed illegal land occupation with Zhang Zhongyu.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以附都猛安戶不自種，悉租與民，有一家百口壟無一苗者。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because capital-attached meng'an households did not cultivate for themselves and rented everything to the people, there was one household of one hundred mouths whose fields had not a single seedling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1182), because capital-attached meng'an households farmed nothing themselves and leased all their land to civilians, one household of one hundred members had not a single seedling in its fields.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「勸農官，何勸諭為也，其令治罪。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "What sort of encouragement do agricultural officials provide? Order them punished."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "What sort of agricultural encouragement are these officials providing? Order them punished."

sentences.zh: 」宰臣奏曰：「不自種而輒與人者，合科違例。

translations.literal: " The chief ministers memorialized: "Those who do not cultivate themselves but promptly give land to others violate regulations."
translations.idiomatic: " The chief ministers replied: "Those who fail to farm themselves but lease land to others violate regulations."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「太重，愚民安知。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Too severe—the foolish people cannot know."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Too harsh—how would simple folk know better?"

sentences.zh: 」遂從大興少尹王修所奏，以不種者杖六十，謀克四十，受租百姓無罪。

translations.literal: " They then followed the memorial of Daxing Vice Prefect Wang Xiu: non-cultivators were beaten sixty strokes, mouke forty, and rent-receiving commoners were not guilty.
translations.idiomatic: " They adopted the proposal of Daxing Vice Prefect Wang Xiu: non-cultivators received sixty strokes, mouke leaders forty, and rent-paying civilians were held blameless.

sentences.zh: 又命招複梁山濼流民，官給以田。

translations.literal: An order was also issued to recall displaced people of Liangshan Marsh and grant them government land.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered displaced people of Liangshan Marsh recalled and granted government land.

sentences.zh: 時人戶有執契據指墳壟為驗者，亦拘在官，先委恩州刺史奚晦招之，複遣安肅州刺史張國基驗實給之，如已撥系猛安，則償以官田。

translations.literal: At this time some households held contracts pointing to grave mounds as proof; these were also held by the government. Enzhou Prefect Xi Hui was first commissioned to recruit them; Ansu Prefect Zhang Guoji was then sent to verify and grant land. If land had already been allotted to a meng'an unit, compensation was made with government fields.
translations.idiomatic: Some households held contracts citing grave mounds as proof of ownership; these too were held in escrow. Enzhou Prefect Xi Hui was first commissioned to recruit returnees; Ansu Prefect Zhang Guoji was then sent to verify claims and grant land. Where allotments had already gone to meng'an units, compensation was paid in government fields.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「工部尚書張九思執強不通，向遣刷官田，凡犯秦、漢以來名稱，如長城、燕子城之類者，皆以為官田。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Minister of Works Zhang Jiusi is obstinate and unreasonable. When sent to consolidate government fields, wherever names from Qin and Han times appeared, such as Great Wall and Swallow City, he treated them all as government land."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Minister of Works Zhang Jiusi is rigid and unreasonable. During the government land consolidation, any place bearing a name from Qin and Han times—Great Wall, Swallow City, and the like—he treated as government land."

sentences.zh: 此田百姓為己業不知幾百年矣，所見如此，何不通之甚也。

translations.literal: This land has been the people's own holdings for who knows how many hundreds of years—yet this is what he saw. How utterly unreasonable!
translations.idiomatic: Commoners have held this land as private property for centuries—yet this was his judgment. How utterly unreasonable!

sentences.zh: 」八月，以趙王永中等四王府冒占官田，罪其各府長史府掾，及安次，新城，宛平、昌平、永清、懷柔六縣官，皆罰贖有差。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month, because the four princely establishments of Zhao Wang Yongzhong and others encroached on government land, their chief administrators and clerks were punished, as were officials of the six counties of Anci, Xincheng, Wanping, Changping, Yongqing, and Huairou—all fined ransoms in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month, because the establishments of Princes Zhao, Yong, and two others encroached on government land, their chief administrators and clerks were punished, along with officials of Anci, Xincheng, Wanping, Changping, Yongqing, and Huairou—all fined in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 九月，遣刑部尚書移剌慥于山東路猛安內摘八謀克民，徙于河北東路酬斡、青狗兒兩猛安舊居之地，無牛者官給之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Minister of Justice Yelü Gao was sent to select people from eight mouke units within Shandong meng'an and relocate them to the former dwellings of the Chouwo and Qinggou'er meng'an units in Hebei East Circuit; those without oxen were supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Minister of Justice Yelü Gao was sent to select households from eight mouke units in Shandong meng'an and relocate them to the former territories of the Chouwo and Qinggou'er meng'an in Hebei East Circuit; those without oxen received government supplies.

sentences.zh: 河間宗室未徙者令盡徙于平州，無力者官津發之，土薄者易以良田。

translations.literal: Imperial clan members in Hejian who had not yet moved were ordered to move entirely to Pingzhou; those without means were transported at government expense; those with poor soil were exchanged for good fields.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clan members in Hejian who had not yet relocated were ordered to move to Pingzhou; the indigent received government transport, and those on poor soil received exchanges for fertile fields.

sentences.zh: 先嘗令俟豐年則括籍官地，至是歲，省臣複以為奏，上曰：「本為新徙四猛安貧窮，須刷官田與之，若張仲愈等所擬條約太刻，但以民初無得地之由，自撫定後未嘗輸稅，妄通為己業者，刷之。

translations.literal: Earlier it had been ordered to wait for a bountiful year before registering and consolidating government land. In this year the provincial ministers again memorialized on it. The emperor said: "This was originally because the four newly relocated meng'an were poor and government land needed to be consolidated and given to them. If the regulations drafted by Zhang Zhongyu and others are too harsh—but only where the people originally had no basis for obtaining land, and since pacification have never paid tax, yet falsely connected it as their own holdings—consolidate those."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the court had ordered land consolidation deferred until a bountiful year. When the provincial ministers raised the matter again that year, the emperor said: "The consolidation was meant to aid four newly relocated impoverished meng'an units. Zhang Zhongyu's proposed regulations are too harsh—consolidate only land that people had no legitimate claim to, that they never taxed since pacification, yet falsely held as private property."

sentences.zh: 如此，恐民苦之，可為酬直。

translations.literal: In this way, I fear the people will suffer; compensation may be provided.
translations.idiomatic: Even so, the people may suffer hardship—provide compensation.

sentences.zh: 且先令猛安謀克人戶，隨宜分處，計其丁壯牛具，合得土田實數，給之。

translations.literal: Moreover, let meng'an-mouke households first be distributed as appropriate, calculating their adult males, oxen, and implements, and grant the actual amount of land they should receive.
translations.idiomatic: First distribute meng'an-mouke households as appropriate, calculating adult males, oxen, and implements, and grant the land they are entitled to.

sentences.zh: 不足，則以前所刷地二萬餘頃補之。

translations.literal: If insufficient, supplement with the more than twenty thousand qing previously consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient, supplement from the more than twenty thousand qing previously consolidated.

sentences.zh: 複不足，則續當議。

translations.literal: If still insufficient, deliberation will continue.
translations.idiomatic: If still insufficient, further measures will be deliberated.

sentences.zh: 」時有落兀者與婆薩等爭懿州地六萬頃，以皆無據驗，遂沒入官。

translations.literal: " At this time Luowu'er and Pos'a disputed sixty thousand qing of land in Yizhou; because both lacked proof, it was confiscated into government holdings.
translations.idiomatic: " At this time Luowu'er and Pos'a disputed sixty thousand qing in Yizhou; lacking proof on either side, the land was confiscated for the state.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，隨處官豪之家多請占官地，轉與它人種佃，規取課利。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, everywhere powerful official families widely requested and occupied government land, transferred it to others for cultivation and tenancy, and schemed to extract rent profits.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1187), powerful official families everywhere widely claimed government land, sublet it for cultivation, and extracted rent profits.

sentences.zh: 命有司拘刷見數，以與貧難無地者，每丁授五十畝，庶不至失所，餘佃不盡者方許豪家驗丁租佃。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to seize and consolidate what was found, grant it to the poor without land—fifty mu per adult male—so they might not lose their livelihood; only what remained unrented might powerful families rent by verified head count.
translations.idiomatic: Responsible offices were ordered to consolidate discovered holdings and grant them to landless poor—fifty mu per adult male—so none would be displaced; only surplus land might powerful families rent according to verified household size.

sentences.zh: 章宗大定二十九年五月，擬再立限，令貧民請佃官地，緣今已過期，計已數足，其占而有餘者，若容告訐，恐滋奸弊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading under Emperor Zhangzong, it was proposed to set a new deadline for the poor to request tenancy of government land; because the present deadline had passed and the quota was deemed sufficient, for those who occupied with surplus, if informing were permitted, I fear corrupt practices would multiply.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, officials proposed a new deadline for poor tenants to claim government land; the prior deadline had passed and quotas were deemed met—for surplus occupiers, permitting informants might breed corruption.

sentences.zh: 況續告漏通地，敕旨已革，今限外告者宜卻之，止付元佃。

translations.literal: Moreover, continued reports of concealed and evaded land—the edict on this has already been revoked; those who report outside the deadline should be rejected, and land returned only to the original tenants.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, edicts on reporting concealed land have been revoked; informants filing after the deadline should be rejected, and land returned only to original tenants.

sentences.zh: 兼平陽一路地狹人稠，官地當盡數拘籍，驗丁以給貧民。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the Pingyang circuit alone the land is narrow and the people dense; government land should be fully registered and recorded, and distributed to poor people according to adult males verified.
translations.idiomatic: In Pingyang circuit as well, where land was scarce and population thick, the court ordered every parcel of government land registered in full and allotted to the poor by household head count.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「限外指告多佃官地者，卻之，當矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "For those who report beyond the limit that many are tenanting government land, reject them—that is right."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Reports that exceed the quota, accusing many of tenanting government land, should be turned aside—and rightly so."

sentences.zh: 如無主不顧承佃，方許諸人告請。

translations.literal: Only when there is no claimant and no one is willing to undertake tenancy may others be permitted to petition.
translations.idiomatic: Others may petition only when the land has no registered holder and no one will take it on lease.

sentences.zh: 其平陽路宜計丁限田，如一家三丁己業止三十畝，則更許存所佃官地一頃二十畝，餘者拘籍給付貧民可也。

translations.literal: For Pingyang circuit, land limits per adult male should be calculated: if a household of three adult males has only thirty mu of private land, then they may additionally retain one qing and twenty mu of government land they tenant; the rest may be registered and given to poor people.
translations.idiomatic: In Pingyang, per-capita land limits should apply: a household of three adult males with only thirty mu of private holdings might keep an additional qing and twenty mu of leased government land; whatever remained would be registered and reassigned to the poor.

sentences.zh: 」七月，論旨尚書省曰：「唐、鄧、潁、蔡、宿、泗等處，水陸膏腴之地，若驗等級，量立歲租，寬其征納之限，募民佃之，公私有益。

translations.literal: "In the seventh month, an edict to the Ministry of Revenue said: "In Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Su, Si, and other places, the fertile lands by water and land—if grades are verified, annual rent is set by measure, the levy period is relaxed, and people are recruited to tenant them—both public and private interests will benefit."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the throne instructed the Ministry: "At Tang, Deng, Ying, Cai, Su, Si, and elsewhere lie rich lands watered by river and canal. Grade the fields, fix annual rent accordingly, ease collection deadlines, and recruit tenants—state and subjects alike would gain."

sentences.zh: 今河南沿邊地多為豪民冒占，若民或流移至彼，就募令耕，不惟貧民有贍，亦增羨官租。

translations.literal: Now along the Henan border much land has been illegally occupied by powerful families; if people migrate there and are recruited to cultivate, not only will poor people have sustenance, but official rent will also increase.
translations.idiomatic: Much borderland in Henan had been seized by local magnates. If displaced peasants were settled there under recruitment to farm, the poor would be fed and the treasury's rent would swell besides.

sentences.zh: 其給丁壯者田及耕具，而免其租稅。

translations.literal: Give able-bodied men land and farming tools, and exempt them from rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: Able-bodied settlers were to receive fields and implements, with rent and tax waived.

sentences.zh: 」八月，尚書省奏：「河東地狹，稍凶荒則流亡相繼。

translations.literal: "In the eighth month the Ministry memorialized: "Hedong land is narrow; when there is even slight famine, exodus follows in succession."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Ministry reported: "Hedong is cramped; the slightest bad harvest sends people fleeing in waves."

sentences.zh: 竊謂河南地廣人稀，若令招集他路流民，量給閒田，則河東饑民減少，河南且無曠地矣。

translations.literal: We humbly suggest that Henan is broad and sparsely populated; if migrants from other circuits are gathered and idle land is allotted by measure, Hedong's starving people will decrease and Henan will no longer have fallow land.
translations.idiomatic: "Henan is wide and thinly peopled," they argued. "Summon refugees from other circuits, grant them spare fields in measured allotments, and Hedong's hungry would diminish while Henan's idle soil was put to use."

sentences.zh: 」上從所請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，又奏：「在制，諸人請佃官閑地者免五年租課，今乞免八年，則或多墾。

translations.literal: On the ninth month's day wuyin, they memorialized again: "Under existing regulation, those who petition to tenant idle government land are exempt from rent for five years; we now request eight years, so that more may be reclaimed."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the ninth month they petitioned again: "The rule grants five years' rent-free tenancy on idle government land; we ask for eight, to encourage more reclamation."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was granted.

sentences.zh: 十一月，尚書省奏：「民驗丁佃河南荒閑官地者，如願作官地則免租八年，願為己業則免稅三年，並不許貿易典賣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Ministry memorialized: "For people who tenant idle government wasteland in Henan by verified adult males—if they wish to keep it as government land, exempt rent for eight years; if they wish it as private property, exempt tax for three years; in neither case may it be sold or pawned."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Ministry proposed: "Tenants of Henan's idle government wasteland, counted by household males, may hold it as leased government land with eight years' rent forgiven, or claim it as private land with three years' tax forgiven—but neither arrangement permits sale or pawn."

sentences.zh: 若豪強及公吏輩有冒佃者，限兩月陳首，免罪而全給之，其稅則視其鄰地定之，以三分為率減一分，限外許諸人告詣給之。

translations.literal: If powerful families and official clerks have illegally tenanted land, they are given two months to confess; punishment is waived and full possession granted; tax is set by neighboring land, reduced by one part in three; beyond the limit others may report and receive the land.
translations.idiomatic: Magnates and clerks who had encroached illegally were allowed two months to confess: no penalty, full title restored, tax assessed against neighboring fields at a one-third reduction. After the deadline, anyone might denounce them and take the land.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The statute was enacted.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年二月，諭旨有司曰：「瀕水民地，已種蒔而為水浸者，可令以所近官田對給。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Mingchang, an edict to officials said: "Where civilian land by the water was already planted but has been inundated, it may be exchanged for nearby government fields."
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 1, second month, officials were told: "Where floodwater has drowned fields peasants had already sown along the waterways, compensate them with adjacent government land of equal measure."

sentences.zh: 」三月，敕：「當軍人所受田，止令自種，力不足者方許人承佃，亦止隨地所產納租，其自欲折錢輸納者從民所欲，不願承佃者毋強。

translations.literal: "In the third month a decree said: "Soldiers' allotted land is for self-cultivation only; only when their strength is insufficient may others undertake tenancy, and rent is paid only according to what the land yields; those who wish to pay in cash may do as they please; those unwilling to tenant must not be forced."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month an order ran: "Land granted to soldiers must be worked by the soldier himself. Only if he lacks the strength may another tenant it, paying rent in kind according to yield—or in cash, if he prefers. No one who refuses tenancy shall be compelled."

sentences.zh: 」六月，尚書省奏：「近制以猛安謀克戶不務栽植桑果，已令每十畝須栽一畝，今乞再下各路提刑及所屬州縣，勸諭民戶，如有不栽及栽之不及十之三者，並以事怠慢輕重罪科之。

translations.literal: "In the sixth month the Ministry memorialized: "Under a recent regulation, because meng'an-mouke households did not devote themselves to planting mulberry and fruit trees, it was already ordered that one mu must be planted for every ten mu; we now request that this be sent again to the judicial commissioners of each circuit and their subordinate prefectures and counties to exhort the households; if any fail to plant, or plant less than one-third of the requirement, all shall be punished according to the gravity of their negligence."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Ministry noted: "Meng'an-mouke households have neglected mulberry and orchards; the rule already requires one planted mu per ten. Send the order again through circuit commissioners and local magistrates. Those who omit planting, or plant less than a third of the quota, should be punished in proportion to their slackness."

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: The edict was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was approved.

sentences.zh: 八月，敕：「隨處系官閑地，百姓已請佃者仍舊，未佃者以付屯田猛安謀克。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a decree said: "Idle government land everywhere—where commoners have already petitioned to tenant, leave matters as before; what remains un-tenanted shall be handed to garrison meng'an-mouke."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the throne decreed: "Wherever idle government land lay, existing peasant leases would stand; unleased parcels would pass to garrison meng'an-mouke units."

sentences.zh: 」三年六月，尚書省奏：「南京、陝西路提刑司言，舊牧馬地久不分撥，以致軍民起訟，比差官往各路定之。

translations.literal: "In the sixth month of the third year the Ministry memorialized: "The judicial offices of the Nanjing and Shaanxi circuits report that old horse pasture land has long gone undivided, causing lawsuits between soldiers and civilians; officials have recently been dispatched to each circuit to settle the matter."
translations.idiomatic: In year three, sixth month, the Ministry relayed complaints from Nanjing and Shaanxi: old pasture boundaries had never been drawn, sparking endless suits between soldiers and civilians. Inspectors were sent circuit by circuit to fix the lines.

sentences.zh: 凡民戶有憑驗己業，及宅井墳園，已改正給付，而其中複有官地者，亦驗數對易之矣。

translations.literal: For households with verified private land, homes, wells, and graveyards, corrections have already been made and land returned; where government land still lay within their holdings, it too was exchanged by verified measure.
translations.idiomatic: Households with documented private fields, homesteads, wells, and burial grounds had already been corrected and restored; any government land mixed into those holdings was swapped out acre for acre.

sentences.zh: 兩路牧地，南京路六萬三千五百二十餘頃，陝西路三萬五千六百八十餘頃。

translations.literal: Pasture in the two circuits: Nanjing circuit, more than sixty-three thousand five hundred twenty qing; Shaanxi circuit, more than thirty-five thousand six hundred eighty qing.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture totaled in the two circuits to 63,520-odd qing in Nanjing and 35,680-odd qing in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 」五年，諭旨尚書省：「遼東等路女直、漢兒百姓，可並令量力為蠶桑。

translations.literal: "In the fifth year an edict to the Ministry said: "In Eastern Liaodong and other circuits, Jurchen and Han commoners alike should be ordered, according to their capacity, to raise silkworms and mulberry."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the court told the Ministry: "In Eastern Liaodong and elsewhere, Jurchen and Han subjects alike should be required, each as he was able, to take up sericulture and mulberry planting."

sentences.zh: 」二月，陳言人乞以長吏勸農立殿最，遂定制：「能勸農田者，每年謀克賞銀絹十兩匹，猛安倍之，縣官于本等升五人。

translations.literal: "In the second month a memorialist requested that local officials be ranked for encouraging agriculture; a regulation was then fixed: "Those who can encourage farming—each year the mouke is rewarded ten taels of silver and bolts of silk, the meng'an double that, and five county officials of their rank are promoted."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month a petitioner asked that magistrates be graded on how well they encouraged farming. The new rule promised ten taels of silver and bolts of silk yearly to each mouke who succeeded, double that to each meng'an, and promotion within rank for five county officials.

sentences.zh: 三年不怠者猛安謀克遷一官，縣官升一等。

translations.literal: Those who do not slack for three years—the meng'an-mouke advance one office, county officials rise one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Three years without lapse would advance a meng'an-mouke one rank and raise a county magistrate one grade.

sentences.zh: 田荒及十之一者笞三十，分數加至徒一年。

translations.literal: If fallow land reaches one-tenth, thirty blows; by proportion the penalty increases up to one year of penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: Land left fallow to one-tenth of the allotment earned thirty strokes of the bastinado; larger fractions escalated to a year's penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 三年皆荒者，猛安謀克追一官，縣官以升等法降之。

translations.literal: If all three years are fallow, the meng'an-mouke is demoted one rank, and county officials are lowered according to the promotion law.
translations.idiomatic: Three consecutive years of total neglect cost a meng'an-mouke one rank and dropped a county official by the inverse of the promotion scale.

sentences.zh: 」為永格。

translations.literal: This was made a permanent statute.
translations.idiomatic: The measure became permanent law.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，詔罷括陝西之地。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, a decree abolished land consolidation in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, second month, the court canceled land consolidation in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 又陝西提刑司言：「本路戶民安水磨、油栿，所占步數在私地有稅，官田則有租，若更輸水利錢銀，是重並也，乞除之。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi judicial office also reported: "Households in this circuit operating water mills and oil presses—the area they occupy on private land is taxed, on government land rented; if they must also pay waterworks silver, that is a double burden; we request its abolition."
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's judicial commissioner added: "Households running water mills and oil presses pay tax on private ground they occupy and rent on government ground. A further waterworks levy piles burden on burden—we ask that it be lifted."

sentences.zh: 」省臣奏：「水利錢銀以輔本路之用，未可除也，宜視實占地數，除稅租。

translations.literal: Ministry officials memorialized: "Waterworks silver supplements this circuit's expenses and cannot yet be abolished; the occupied area should be verified, and tax and rent exempted accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry replied: "Waterworks silver supports the circuit's budget and cannot be scrapped outright. Measure the land actually used and waive tax or rent on that basis instead."

sentences.zh: 」命他路視此為法。

translations.literal: Other circuits were ordered to take this as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Other circuits were told to follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，遣戶部郎中上官瑜往西京並沿邊，勸舉軍民耕種。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an, Households Bureau Director Shangguan Yu was sent to the Western Capital and the border regions to encourage soldiers and civilians to cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: In Cheng'an 2, Shangguan Yu of the Households Bureau was dispatched to the Western Capital and the frontier to urge soldiers and civilians into the fields.

sentences.zh: 又差戶部郎中李敬義往臨潢等路規畫農事。

translations.literal: Households Bureau Director Li Jingyi was also sent to Linhuang and other circuits to plan agricultural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingyi of the same bureau was sent to Linhuang and neighboring circuits to lay out agricultural policy.

sentences.zh: 舊令，軍人所授之地不得租賃與人，違者苗付地主。

translations.literal: Under the old rule, land granted to soldiers must not be leased to others; violators' crop yield went to the landholder.
translations.idiomatic: By the old statute, soldiers could not lease out their allotments; offenders forfeited the year's crop to the nominal holder.

sentences.zh: 泰和四年九月定制，所撥地土十裏內自種之數，每丁四十畝，續進丁同此，余者許令便宜租賃及兩和分種，違者錢業還主。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Taihe a regulation was fixed: within ten li of allotted land, the amount for self-cultivation is forty mu per adult male, the same for each additional adult; the remainder may be leased or share-cropped at discretion; violators' money and land are returned to the holder.
translations.idiomatic: Taihe 4, ninth month, fixed new terms: within ten li of a soldier's grant, each adult male must farm forty mu himself, each additional male the same; surplus land might be leased or share-cropped freely. Violators lost both payment and title.

sentences.zh: 上聞六路括地時，其間屯田軍戶多冒名增口，以請官地，及包取民田，而民有空輸稅賦、虛抱物力者，應詔陳言人多論之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that during land consolidation in the six circuits, garrison households often falsely inflated household size to claim government land and encroached on civilian fields, while civilians paid empty taxes and bore fictitious property obligations; many memorialists responded to the edict calling for opinions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned that during the six-circuit land consolidation, garrison households had inflated rolls to grab government land and swallowed civilian plots, leaving commoners paying tax on fields they did not hold. Petitioners flooded the court under the open-call edict.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，尚書省奏：「若複遣官分往，追照案憑，訟言紛紛，何時已乎？

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year the Ministry memorialized: "If officials are again sent out separately to verify records and credentials, lawsuits and disputes will be endless—when will it ever end?"
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, second month, the Ministry warned: "Send inspectors out again to chase every deed and docket, and the lawsuits will never end."

sentences.zh: 」遂令虛抱稅石已輸送入官者，命於稅內每歲續克之。

translations.literal: It was then ordered that those who had already paid and delivered grain for fictitious tax obligations should have it deducted annually from their tax.
translations.idiomatic: The court ruled instead that grain already paid on phantom assessments would be written off year by year against future tax.

sentences.zh: 泰和七年，募民種佃清河等處地，以其租分為諸春水處餌鵝鴨之食。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Taihe, people were recruited to plant and tenant land at Qinghe and elsewhere; the rent was divided to feed geese and ducks at various spring-water sites.
translations.idiomatic: Taihe 7 recruited tenants for Qinghe and neighboring districts; the rent was earmarked to feed geese and ducks kept at the spring ponds.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，戶部尚書高汝礪言：「舊制，人戶請佃荒地者，以各路最下第五等減半定租，仍免八年輸納。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year of Taihe, Minister of Revenue Gao Ruli said: "Under the old system, households petitioning to tenant wasteland had rent set at half the fifth-lowest grade in each circuit, with eight years' payment exempted."
translations.idiomatic: Taihe 8, eighth month: Revenue Minister Gao Ruli reported: "Under the old rule, wasteland tenants paid half the fifth-lowest circuit rate and owed nothing for eight years."

sentences.zh: 若作己業，並依第七等稅錢減半，亦免三年輸納。

translations.literal: If taken as private property, tax money was likewise halved according to the seventh grade, with three years' payment exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Those who converted holdings to private land paid half the seventh-grade tax and enjoyed three years' exemption.

sentences.zh: 自首冒佃比鄰田，定租三分納二。

translations.literal: Those who confessed to illegally tenanted neighboring land paid two parts in three of the assessed rent.
translations.idiomatic: Encroachers who came forward paid two-thirds of the rent fixed on adjoining fields.

sentences.zh: 其請佃黃河退灘地者，次年納租。

translations.literal: Those petitioning to tenant Yellow River retreat beach land paid rent the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants of the river's newly exposed shoals began paying rent in the second year.

sentences.zh: 向者小民不為久計，比至納租之時多巧避匿，或複告退，蓋由元限太遠，請佃之初無人保識故爾。

translations.literal: Formerly commoners did not plan for the long term; when rent came due many cleverly evaded or again petitioned to withdraw—because the original exemption period was too long and no one guaranteed them at the outset of tenancy.
translations.idiomatic: Peasants had played short games: when rent fell due they dodged, disclaimed, or petitioned to quit—because the old grace period was too long and no neighbor stood surety when they first leased.

sentences.zh: 今請佃者可免三年，作己業者免一年，自首冒佃並請退灘地，並令當年輸租，以鄰首保識，為長制。」

translations.literal: Now tenants may be exempt for three years, those taking land as private property for one year; self-confessed illegal tenancy and petitions for retreat beach land must all pay rent the same year, with neighborhood heads as guarantors—this is to be a permanent regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth tenancy would carry three rent-free years, private conversion one tax-free year; confessors and shoal tenants would pay immediately, with headmen of the lane as guarantors—a standing rule going forward."

sentences.zh: 宣宗貞祐三年七月，以既徙河北軍戶于河南，議所以處之者。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Zhenyou under Emperor Xuanzong, because Hebei military households had already been moved to Henan, the court discussed how to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong, Zhenyou 3, seventh month: with Hebei's garrison households already relocated to Henan, the court debated how to support them.

sentences.zh: 宰臣曰：「當指官田及牧地分畀之，已為民佃者則俟秋獲後，仍日給米一升，折以分鈔。

translations.literal: The councilors said: "Government land and pasture should be pointed out and divided among them; where land is already tenanted by civilians, wait until the autumn harvest; still give one sheng of rice daily per person, converted to fractional paper notes."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers proposed carving up government fields and pasture. Where peasants already leased the soil, wait for autumn harvest—but keep issuing one sheng of rice a day per mouth, commuted to paper notes.

sentences.zh: 」太常丞石抹世績曰：「荒田牧地耕辟費力。

translations.literal: Grand Ceremonialist Shimamo Shiji said: "Wasteland and pasture are exhausting to open for cultivation."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ceremonialist Shimamo Shiji objected: "Wild fields and pasture cost dearly to break."

sentences.zh: 奪民素墾則民失所。

translations.literal: Seizing civilians' long-cultivated land leaves the people without livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Strip peasants of land they have worked for generations and they have nowhere to stand.

sentences.zh: 況軍戶率無牛，宜令軍戶分人歸守本業，至春複還，為固守計。

translations.literal: Moreover military households mostly lack oxen; the military households should be allowed to send men back in rotation to guard their original occupations, returning again in spring—a plan for holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison families rarely own oxen. Better to rotate men home to their old farms until spring, then march them back—sound policy for a war of attrition.

sentences.zh: 」上卒從宰臣議，將括之，侍御史劉元規上書曰：「伏見朝廷有括地之議，聞者無不駭愕。

translations.literal: The emperor finally followed the councilors' plan and was about to consolidate land; Attendant Censor Liu Yuangui submitted a memorial saying: "I see that the court has a plan for land consolidation; all who hear of it are shocked and alarmed."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sided with the ministers and moved toward consolidation—until Attendant Censor Liu Yuangui wrote: "Word of another land roundup has spread; everyone who hears it is appalled."

sentences.zh: 向者河北、山東已為此舉，民之塋墓井灶悉為有軍有，怨嗟爭訟至今未絕，若複行之，則將大失眾心，荒田不可耕，徒有得地之名，而無享利之實。

translations.literal: Previously Hebei and Shandong already undertook this measure; civilians' graves, wells, and hearths all became the property of powerful claimants; resentment, lament, and lawsuits have not ceased to this day; if it is done again, the court will greatly lose the people's hearts; wasteland cannot be cultivated—there will be only the name of gaining land, without the reality of enjoying its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei and Shandong had already tried it: graves, wells, and hearthstones were seized by the powerful, and the grumbling and litigation never stopped. Repeat the experiment and the throne loses the people's trust. Wasteland cannot be farmed—you gain acreage on paper, not harvest in the granary.

sentences.zh: 縱得熟土，不能親耕，而複令民佃之，所得無幾，而使紛紛交病哉！

translations.literal: Even if fertile soil is obtained, they cannot farm it themselves, yet civilians are again made to tenant it—the gain is slight, while all sides suffer in confusion!"
translations.idiomatic: Even fertile plots would go untilled by soldiers who then press peasants to rent them—little revenue, much misery all around!"

sentences.zh: 」上大悟，罷之。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly enlightened and abolished the plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw the force of it and dropped the scheme.

sentences.zh: 八月，先以括地事未有定論，北方侵及河南，由是盡起諸路軍戶南來。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, first because the land consolidation matter had no final decision, the north invaded as far as Henan; thereby all military households from the various circuits came south.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, with consolidation still unsettled, northern armies pressed into Henan and garrison households from every circuit streamed south.

sentences.zh: 共圖保守，而不能知所以得軍糧之術。

translations.literal: Together they planned defense, but did not know the method by which to obtain military grain.
translations.idiomatic: They resolved to hold the line—but had no plan to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 眾議謂可分遣官聚耆老問之，其將益賦，或與軍田，二者孰便。

translations.literal: General discussion held that officials might be dispatched to gather elders and ask them whether increasing levies or granting military fields would be more convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Debate turned to sending commissioners to consult village elders: raise taxes, or grant army land—which served better?

sentences.zh: 參政汝礪言：「河南官民地相半，又多全佃官地之家，一旦奪之，何以自活？

translations.literal: Councilor Ruli said: "In Henan government and civilian land are half and half, and many households wholly tenant government land; if it is seized at once, how will they live?"
translations.idiomatic: Councilor Gao Ruli argued: "Henan splits evenly between government and private land, and many families live entirely on leased government fields. Seize those overnight and they starve."

sentences.zh: 小民易動難安，一時避賦遂有舍田之言，及與人能勿悔乎，悔則忿心生矣！

translations.literal: Small people are easily stirred and hard to settle; for a time they avoid levies and then speak of abandoning their fields; when land is given them, can they avoid regret? When regret comes, anger is born!"
translations.idiomatic: Common folk are quick to panic and slow to calm. Fleeing taxes they talk of walking away from their farms; hand land back and can they not regret it? Regret breeds rage.

sentences.zh: 如山東撥地時，腴地盡入富家，瘠者乃付貧戶，無益於軍，而民有損。

translations.literal: As when land was allocated in Shandong, fertile land all went to rich families while poor land was given to poor households—no benefit to the army, but harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Remember Shandong: rich soil to the wealthy, stony scraps to the poor—no gain for the army, only loss for the people.

sentences.zh: 惟當倍益官租，以給軍食。

translations.literal: Only government rent should be doubled to supply military food.
translations.idiomatic: Double the rent on government land and feed the troops from that.

sentences.zh: 複以系官荒田牧地量數與之，令其自耕，則民不失業，官不厲民矣！

translations.literal: Also give measured idle government wasteland and pasture for self-cultivation; then civilians will not lose their livelihood and the state will not oppress the people!"
translations.idiomatic: Grant measured plots of idle government wasteland and pasture for soldiers to work themselves—civilians keep their livelihood, the state avoids crushing the people.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，高汝礪言：「河北軍戶徙居河南者幾百萬口，人日給米一升，歲費三百六十萬石，半以給直，猶支粟三百萬石。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year Gao Ruli said: "Hebei military households who have moved to Henan number nearly a million mouths; one sheng of rice per person daily costs three million six hundred thousand shi yearly; even paying half in cash, three million shi of grain are still disbursed."
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, year three: Gao Ruli calculated that nearly a million relocated Hebei mouths ate one sheng of rice a day—3.6 million shi yearly; even halving cash payments, grain still ran to three million shi.

sentences.zh: 河南租地計二十四萬頃，歲租才一百五十六萬，乞於經費之外倍征以給之。

translations.literal: Rented land in Henan totals two hundred forty thousand qing; annual rent is only one million five hundred sixty thousand; we request doubling the levy beyond ordinary expenses to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's leased fields totaled 240,000 qing yielding only 1.56 million in rent. He asked to double collections beyond routine revenue to cover the bill.

sentences.zh: 」遂命右司諫馮開等五人分詣諸郡，就授以荒官田及牧地可耕者，人三十畝。

translations.literal: Five men including Right Supervisor of Remonstrance Feng Kai were then ordered to separate circuits and counties, granting cultivable wasteland government land and pasture on the spot—thirty mu per person.
translations.idiomatic: Five officials led by Right Remonstrance Supervisor Feng Kai were sent county by county to assign thirty mu of cultivable wasteland or pasture to each man on the spot.

sentences.zh: 十一月，又議以括荒田及牧馬地給軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, land consolidation of wasteland and horse pasture to supply the army was again discussed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the court again debated consolidating wasteland and horse pasture for the troops.

sentences.zh: 命尚書右丞高汝礪總之。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Gao Ruli was ordered to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Gao Ruli was put in charge.

sentences.zh: 汝礪還奏：「今頃畝之數較之舊籍甚少，複瘠惡不可耕，均以可耕者與之，人得無幾。

translations.literal: Ruli returned and memorialized: "The present count in qing and mu is far less than the old register; much is also poor and uncultivable; averaging what can be cultivated, each person receives little."
translations.idiomatic: Gao returned with bad news: "Measured against old rolls, today's qing and mu are paltry—and much of it barren. Split the tillable portion and each man gets almost nothing."

sentences.zh: 又僻遠之處必徙居以就之，彼皆不能自耕，必以與人，又當取租於數百里之外。

translations.literal: Moreover, remote places require relocation to reach them; those people cannot farm for themselves and must lease out, then collect rent from hundreds of li away.
translations.idiomatic: Remote allotments force families to move; they cannot farm alone, must sublet, then chase rent across hundreds of li.

sentences.zh: 況今農田且不能盡辟，豈有餘力以耕叢薄交固、草根糾結之荒地哉！

translations.literal: Moreover, present farmland cannot even be fully opened—how could there be spare strength to cultivate wasteland tangled with brush and knotted roots!"
translations.idiomatic: Existing fields are not fully worked—who has strength left for brush-choked, root-bound wilderness?

sentences.zh: 軍不可仰此得食也，審矣。

translations.literal: The army cannot rely on this for food—that is certain.
translations.idiomatic: The army cannot eat from this. That much is certain.

sentences.zh: 今詢諸軍戶，皆曰：'得半糧猶足自養，得田不能耕，複罷其廩，將何所賴？

translations.literal: Inquiring now among military households, all say: 'Half rations are still enough to sustain us; get land we cannot farm and again lose our grain allowance—what shall we rely on?'
translations.idiomatic: Ask the garrison households and they answer: 'Half rations still feed us; give us land we cannot plow and cut our grain—what then?'

sentences.zh: '臣知初籍地之時，未嘗按閱其實，所以不如其數，不得其處也。

translations.literal: I know that when land was first registered, its reality was never inspected on the ground; hence the numbers do not match and the locations are wrong.
translations.idiomatic: The first registry never matched the ground—that is why the figures lie and the plots sit in the wrong places.

sentences.zh: 若複考計州縣，必各妄承風旨，追呼究結以應命。

translations.literal: If counties are again investigated and calculated, each will falsely follow the imperial intent, summoning and pressing inquiries to answer the command.
translations.idiomatic: Send auditors back to every county and each magistrate will fake compliance—summoning, hounding, closing books to satisfy the order.

sentences.zh: 不足其數，則妄指民田以充之，則所在騷然矣！

translations.literal: When the numbers fall short, they will falsely point to civilian fields to fill the quota—then everywhere will be in uproar!"
translations.idiomatic: Short of quota they will mark peasant fields as army land—the whole region will erupt.

sentences.zh: 今民之賦役三倍平時，飛挽轉輸，日不暇給，而複為此舉，何以堪之。

translations.literal: Now the people's levies and corvée are triple the normal level; urgent transport and relay duties leave no day free; to undertake this measure again—how can they bear it?
translations.idiomatic: Peasant burdens already triple peacetime; grain convoys leave no day free—how can they survive another roundup?

sentences.zh: 且軍戶暫遷，行有還期，何為以此病民哉！

translations.literal: Moreover the military households are temporarily relocated and will eventually return—why afflict the people with this?"
translations.idiomatic: These garrison families are only passing through—they will go home. Why scourge the countryside for them?

sentences.zh: 病民而軍獲利，猶不可為，況無所利乎！

translations.literal: To afflict the people while the army profits is still impermissible—how much more when there is no profit!"
translations.idiomatic: Harming civilians to benefit the army would be wrong even if it worked—and it does not work.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下加察。

translations.literal: Only may Your Majesty examine this closely."
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to look closely.

sentences.zh: 」遂詔罷給田，但半給糧、半給實直焉。

translations.literal: A decree then abolished the grant of land; only half grain and half cash payment were given.
translations.idiomatic: The throne canceled land grants and kept half rations, half cash.

sentences.zh: 四年，複遣官括河南牧馬地，既籍其數，上命省院議所以給軍者，宰臣曰：「今軍戶當給糧者四十四萬八千余口，計當口占六畝有奇，繼來者不與焉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, officials were again sent to consolidate Henan horse pasture land; after the numbers were registered, the emperor ordered the ministry and the Court to discuss how to supply the army; the councilors said: "Military households now entitled to grain number more than four hundred forty-eight thousand mouths; by calculation each mouth should occupy a little over six mu; those arriving later are not included."
translations.idiomatic: Year four brought another Henan pasture consolidation. With the rolls complete, the emperor asked the ministry and Court how to provision the troops. Ministers counted 448,000 mouths on grain rolls—roughly six mu each, excluding late arrivals.

sentences.zh: 但相去數百里者，豈能以六畝之故而遠來哉！

translations.literal: But those separated by several hundred li—how could they come from afar for the sake of six mu!"
translations.idiomatic: Men hundreds of li away will not trek home for six mu of scrub.

sentences.zh: 兼月支口糧不可遽罷，臣等竊謂軍戶願佃者即當計口給之。

translations.literal: Moreover monthly grain rations cannot be abruptly stopped; we humbly think that military households willing to tenant should immediately receive allotments counted by mouth.
